lines: The United Nations is officially... closed!
Like forever, buddy. No more rules!
Uh... Mexico? Why are your eyes red?
HEY! I was joking! I WAS JOKING!
Too late, amigo. The rules are closed.
I am going to go hide now. Sorry.
And that... is how the world ended. In about four seconds.
This is THE LAST NATION. Episode one. No more rules.
Right. Emergency meeting. Is all of Europe here?
Hola. Sorry I am late. I was having a siesta.
Spain, it is ten in the morning.
Focus please. The rules are gone. What do we do?
We stay calm. We are civilized people.
Agreed. Nobody in Europe invades anybody.
FRANCE! WE AGREED TWO SECONDS AGO!
Then San Marino is mine! It is literally inside my boot!
Ooh, my turn! Portugal and Andorra!
England! My oldest friend! Help me!
Sorry mate, bit busy. Having tea.
We have been allies for six hundred years!
Do not worry, Portugal. Now you get my siesta too.
Namaste, everyone! India here. One point four billion people.
Pakistan, my friend. Cricket match. Right now.
Fine. The loser stops talking for a week.
Hey India... can I hide behind you? These guys are scary.
Me too, me too! I am very small!
Of course! Come inside. Protection is free.
You are now protected. Very strongly. Forever.
India, you just annexed two countries with a hug.
You told the whole internet that rendang is Malaysian.
Guys! Guys! I am just a tiny city. Please. I sell phones.
Singapore. You are surrounded by me now.
Oi! Indonesia! That is getting a bit close, mate!
Australia. How many people do you have?
I have two hundred and eighty million.
Yeah, but I have spiders. Big ones.
Okay, okay. You win this one.
Sri Lanka! Maldives! Beach holiday with your big brother?
No thank you. I have tea. I am fine.
Actually India, I am slowly sinking into the ocean. Please take me.
I have so much land. Good luck finding a seat on the train.
Indonesia. You took Malaysia. And Singapore. And Brunei. Am I next?
No no no. You are my friend, Philippines.
Hey, I am just standing here!
You were standing too close, Papua. Bad luck.
Hello? China? It is me, America.
I know. I made your phone.
Listen. The rules are gone, so I will be honest with you.
Stay away from my friends in Asia.
Which friends? Japan? Korea? The Philippines?
Funny. They are all very close to me. And very far from you.
I have the factory that makes your aircraft carrier screws.
Excuse me. I have one question for Europe.
Why does the whole world call them French fries?
YOU DID NOT! I INVENTED FRIES!
Actually, guys, fries are American. Look at the menu.
I just put mayonnaise on them. I stay out of this.
Belgium. Do you want to be French? With the fries?
Now they are French fries. Officially.
Netherlands! I am tiny and France is right there! Hide me!
Come here, little Luxembourg. Mayonnaise is safe.
Austria. Liechtenstein. Let us make a little union. A small one.
Neutral is not a country, Switzerland. It is a mood.
Ja, okay, sounds fun. Same language anyway.
Germany. Are you doing the thing again?
This is completely different. I have a spreadsheet.
Germany. I am watching you. Very closely.
I have the biggest army in Europe now. Since last Tuesday.
I bought it online. Two hundred tanks. Free shipping.
And Lithuania! Remember when we were one big country?
That was four hundred years ago!
Okay. Okay. Poland is scary now.
Hello India. I see you got bigger.
Hello Indonesia. You also got bigger.
I have the best food in the world.
No, I have the best food in the world.
Okay. Truce. China is getting very big, my friend.
Alliance. But my biryani is still better.
America. Small question. Do you remember Alaska?
Yeah, I bought it from you. For seven million dollars.
No refunds! It was a hundred and sixty years ago!
Are those ships going to Alaska?!
They are going fishing. Big fishing.
Russia, I am right here. Behind you. With a sauna.
Finland, nobody is afraid of a sauna.
Denmark. We need to talk about Hans Island.
MY island. I left a bottle of whisky there!
And I left a bottle of schnapps. So it is mine.
Guys. The whole world is at war. You are fighting about a rock.
It is a very important rock, America.
Qatar. You have too much gas.
I hosted a World Cup! Everybody loves me!
Everybody was very hot. Nobody loved you.
Brother, relax. Let us buy a football club together.
I already have three football clubs. I want land.
Because I wanted to do that!
CYPRUS?! TURKEY, I WILL NEVER FORGIVE YOU!
Greece, you never forgive me anyway.
Right. Second emergency meeting. Who invaded who?
Monaco and Belgium. For the fries. Very fair.
San Marino. It was inside my boot.
Portugal and Andorra. They were taking my siesta.
Austria and Liechtenstein. With a spreadsheet.
And what about me? I got NOTHING!
Oh, you want to talk about Brexit?!
Iceland! Norway! You love fish. I love fish and chips. Come here!
You cannot just invade two countries for fish and chips!
Watch me. I did it to half the planet once.
England. While everybody is busy... Gibraltar. Give it back.
I will invade it. I have Portugal now. I am very strong.
Hello Spain. I am right across the water. I can see you.
Spain. Touch Gibraltar, and I will take away your siesta.
India and Indonesia. An alliance. Against me?
And Japan is there too. And America behind all of you. As always.
Okay. You want to play? Let us play.
HE JUST TOOK FOUR COUNTRIES IN ONE SENTENCE!
The fleet is moving. Just a little bit. Just in case.
Thank you, America. Please park them over there.
Um. Hello. Why is everyone looking at me?
I just wanted to make computer chips in peace!
My ships are going for a walk. A very big walk.
Then my ships are going for a walk too.
Two superpowers. Two fleets. One tiny island in the middle.
And the whole world is watching.
Guys... please... do not do this...
